original: shouldKeepSessionOpen(config, "implementer") returns true when config.review.enabled is true.
refined: When ExecutionGatesConfig has review.enabled === true and role === "implementer", shouldKeepSessionOpen(config, "implementer") returns true

original: shouldKeepSessionOpen(config, "implementer") returns true when config.execution.rectification.enabled is true.
refined: When ExecutionGatesConfig has execution.rectification.enabled === true and role === "implementer", shouldKeepSessionOpen(config, "implementer") returns true

original: shouldKeepSessionOpen(config, "implementer") returns false when both config.review.enabled and config.execution.rectification.enabled are absent or false.
refined: When ExecutionGatesConfig has review.enabled === false (or undefined) AND execution.rectification.enabled === false (or undefined) and role === "implementer", shouldKeepSessionOpen(config, "implementer") returns false

original: shouldKeepSessionOpen(config, "test-writer") returns false regardless of config.review.enabled and config.execution.rectification.enabled values.
refined: When role === "test-writer", shouldKeepSessionOpen(config, "test-writer") returns false for all combinations of review.enabled and execution.rectification.enabled states

original: shouldKeepSessionOpen(config, "verifier") returns false regardless of config.review.enabled and config.execution.rectification.enabled values.
refined: When role === "verifier", shouldKeepSessionOpen(config, "verifier") returns false for all combinations of review.enabled and execution.rectification.enabled states

original: shouldRunReview(config) returns true when config.review.enabled is true.
refined: When ExecutionGatesConfig has review.enabled === true, shouldRunReview(config) returns true

original: shouldRunReview(config) returns false when config.review is absent.
refined: When ExecutionGatesConfig has review === undefined or review.enabled === undefined, shouldRunReview(config) returns false

original: shouldRunRectification(config) returns true when config.execution.rectification.enabled is true.
refined: When ExecutionGatesConfig has execution.rectification.enabled === true, shouldRunRectification(config) returns true

original: shouldRunRectification(config) returns false when config.execution.rectification is absent.
refined: When ExecutionGatesConfig has execution.rectification === undefined or execution.rectification.enabled === undefined, shouldRunRectification(config) returns false

original: Given `src/tdd/session-runner.ts` is inspected after US-001, when locating keepOpen assignment, then the expression includes `shouldKeepSessionOpen(` and does not include the prior inline `role === "implementer" && (config.execution.rectification?.enabled ?? false)` expression.
refined: File src/tdd/session-runner.ts contains keepOpen assignment using shouldKeepSessionOpen() function call and does not contain the string pattern 'role === "implementer" && (config.execution.rectification?.enabled ?? false)'

original: Given `src/pipeline/stages/execution.ts` is inspected after US-001, when locating keepOpen assignment, then the expression includes `shouldKeepSessionOpen(` and does not include the prior inline `ctx.config.review?.enabled === true || ctx.config.execution.rectification?.enabled === true` expression.
refined: File src/pipeline/stages/execution.ts contains keepOpen assignment using shouldKeepSessionOpen() function call and does not contain the string pattern 'ctx.config.review?.enabled === true || ctx.config.execution.rectification?.enabled === true'

original: SessionKeeper.send() returns the TurnResult from agentManager.runAsSession on success.
refined: SessionKeeper.send(opts) returns a TurnResult object with identical properties to the value returned by agentManager.runAsSession when no errors occur.

original: SessionKeeper.send() calls sessionManager.getLiveHandle(sessionName) before openSession, and when a live handle with matching agentName exists, SessionKeeper.send() reuses that handle.
refined: SessionKeeper.send() invokes sessionManager.getLiveHandle(sessionName) on entry; when the returned handle is non-null and handle.agentName === SessionKeeperOptions.defaultAgent, the same handle is passed to agentManager.runAsSession instead of calling sessionManager.openSession.

original: Given no matching live handle exists, when SessionKeeper.send() runs, then it calls sessionManager.openSession and uses the returned handle.
refined: When sessionManager.getLiveHandle(sessionName) returns null or a handle with handle.agentName !== SessionKeeperOptions.defaultAgent, SessionKeeper.send() calls sessionManager.openSession(sessionName, role, ...) and passes the returned handle to agentManager.runAsSession.

original: Given agentManager.runAsSession throws SessionTurnError with retryable: true, when retryStrategy.shouldRetry returns retry: true, then SessionKeeper.send() closes the stale handle and retries.
refined: When agentManager.runAsSession throws SessionTurnError with error.retryable === true and retryStrategy.shouldRetry(attemptNumber, error) returns { retry: true }, SessionKeeper.send() calls sessionManager.closeSession(staleHandle) and re-enters the send loop with the same prompt.

original: Given agentManager.runAsSession throws SessionTurnError with retryable: true, when retryStrategy is absent or returns retry: false, then SessionKeeper.send() re-throws the error.
refined: When agentManager.runAsSession throws SessionTurnError with error.retryable === true and (SessionKeeperOptions.retryStrategy is undefined OR retryStrategy.shouldRetry(attemptNumber, error) returns { retry: false }), SessionKeeper.send() re-throws the SessionTurnError without retry.

original: Given agentManager.runAsSession throws SessionTurnError with retryable: false, when SessionKeeper.send() handles the error, then it re-throws immediately without calling retryStrategy.shouldRetry.
refined: When agentManager.runAsSession throws SessionTurnError with error.retryable === false, SessionKeeper.send() re-throws the error immediately without invoking retryStrategy.shouldRetry.

original: SessionKeeper.bindProtocolIds() calls sessionManager.bindHandle(heldHandle.id, sessionName, protocolIds) when heldHandle.protocolIds is defined.
refined: SessionKeeper.bindProtocolIds() invokes sessionManager.bindHandle(heldHandle.id, sessionName, heldHandle.protocolIds) exactly once when the held handle is non-null and heldHandle.protocolIds is defined.

original: SessionKeeper.bindProtocolIds() performs no sessionManager.bindHandle call when heldHandle.protocolIds is undefined.
refined: SessionKeeper.bindProtocolIds() does not call sessionManager.bindHandle when heldHandle is null or when heldHandle.protocolIds is undefined.

original: SessionKeeper.close() calls sessionManager.closeSession for the held handle when one exists and does not throw when no handle is held.
refined: SessionKeeper.close() calls sessionManager.closeSession(heldHandle) exactly once when a handle is held; when no handle is held, close() completes without throwing an error.

original: Given `src/verification/rectification-loop.ts` is inspected after US-002, when searching for the previous session retry block, then the previous inline `while (true)` loop used for `getLiveHandle/openSession/runAsSession` is removed and SessionKeeper usage is present.
refined: After US-002 merge, grep of src/verification/rectification-loop.ts matches zero inline `while (true)` loops containing consecutive calls to getLiveHandle, openSession, and runAsSession; and the file contains at least one instantiation of SessionKeeper and at least one call to its send() method.

original: Given `src/tdd/rectification-gate.ts` is inspected after US-002, when searching for the previous session retry block, then the previous inline `while (true)` loop used for `getLiveHandle/openSession/runAsSession` is removed and SessionKeeper usage is present.
refined: After US-002 merge, grep of src/tdd/rectification-gate.ts matches zero inline `while (true)` loops containing consecutive calls to getLiveHandle, openSession, and runAsSession; and the file contains at least one instantiation of SessionKeeper and at least one call to its send() method.

original: implementerOp.kind equals "run", implementerOp.session.role equals "implementer", and implementerOp.session.lifetime equals "warm".
refined: Exported implementerOp object has properties: kind === "run", session.role === "implementer", session.lifetime === "warm"

original: testWriterOp.session.role equals "test-writer" and testWriterOp.session.lifetime equals "fresh".
refined: Exported testWriterOp object has properties: session.role === "test-writer", session.lifetime === "fresh"

original: verifierOp.session.role equals "verifier" and verifierOp.session.lifetime equals "fresh".
refined: Exported verifierOp object has properties: session.role === "verifier", session.lifetime === "fresh"

original: Given implementerOp.parse receives empty or unparseable output, when parse executes, then it returns ImplementerOutput with success: false and filesChanged: [].
refined: implementerOp.parse("") and implementerOp.parse("invalid") each return { success: false, filesChanged: [], estimatedCostUsd: 0, durationMs: 0 } without throwing

original: Given upgraded TDD op parse cannot produce a usable value and op-level recover can derive output from disk artifacts, when callOp post-parse flow runs, then it returns recovered output instead of throwing parse failure.
refined: When callOp executes an op with a failing parse and a defined recover function that derives valid output from disk, callOp returns the recovered output without throwing an error

original: When runTddSessionOp routes by op.session.role, then it dispatches via callOp to implementerOp, testWriterOp, or verifierOp and does not call runTddSession() directly.
refined: runTddSessionOp routes to callOp(ctx, implementerOp, ...), callOp(ctx, testWriterOp, ...), or callOp(ctx, verifierOp, ...) based on session role; source code contains no direct call to runTddSession()

original: Given `src/operations/index.ts` is inspected after US-003, when reading exports, then `TddRunOp` is not exported.
refined: src/operations/index.ts export list does not include TddRunOp or a named export binding to TddRunOp

original: Given role-tag wiring tests are inspected after US-003, when checking `test/unit/tdd/session-op.test.ts`, then the file does not exist.
refined: File test/unit/tdd/session-op.test.ts does not exist in the repository after implementation

original: Given addImplementer was never called, when StoryOrchestratorBuilder.build(ctx) is invoked, then it throws NaxError with code "ORCHESTRATOR_NO_IMPLEMENTER".
refined: When StoryOrchestratorBuilder.build(ctx) is called without calling addImplementer(input) first, then it throws NaxError with code property equal to "ORCHESTRATOR_NO_IMPLEMENTER".

original: Given slots are declared in order, when ExecutionPlan.run() executes, then it runs test-writer (if added), implementer, verifier (if added), semantic review (if added), and rectification (if added) in that order.
refined: When ExecutionPlan.run() is called, all phases execute in sequence: test-writer (if added), then implementer, then verifier (if added), then semantic review (if added), then rectification (if added). Execution order can be verified by inspecting timestamps or call order in logs/traces.

original: When an add* method is not called for a phase, then ExecutionPlan.run() skips that phase and does not emit that phase key in phaseOutputs.
refined: When a phase's add* method is not invoked (e.g., addVerifier is omitted), ExecutionPlan.run() returns StoryOrchestratorResult where phaseOutputs does not contain a key for that phase's op name.

original: ExecutionPlan.run() stores per-phase costs in phaseCosts keyed by op name, stores parsed phase outputs in phaseOutputs keyed by op name, and sets totalCostUsd equal to the numeric sum of phaseCosts values.
refined: StoryOrchestratorResult.phaseCosts contains exactly one entry per executed phase keyed by op name with numeric cost values; StoryOrchestratorResult.phaseOutputs contains exactly one entry per executed phase keyed by op name; StoryOrchestratorResult.totalCostUsd equals the sum of all numeric values in phaseCosts (verified by comparing totalCostUsd to sum of phaseCosts values).

original: Given `src/pipeline/stages/execution.ts` is inspected after US-004, when locating story execution orchestration, then the file uses StoryOrchestratorBuilder/ExecutionPlan and does not contain residual duplicated session-loop orchestration guarded by `if (isTddStrategy)`.
refined: After implementation is complete, src/pipeline/stages/execution.ts must import StoryOrchestratorBuilder and ExecutionPlan from src/execution/story-orchestrator, must call builder.build(ctx).run() to orchestrate story execution, and must not contain any if-statement or branch checking isTddStrategy or similar variables for session management logic.

original: Given `src/tdd/orchestrator.ts` is inspected after US-004, when locating story execution orchestration, then the file uses StoryOrchestratorBuilder/ExecutionPlan for phase sequencing and does not keep independent duplicated session-loop orchestration.
refined: After implementation is complete, src/tdd/orchestrator.ts must import StoryOrchestratorBuilder and ExecutionPlan, must call builder.build(ctx).run() to obtain StoryOrchestratorResult, and must not contain independent session initialization, phase loops, or operation-sequencing logic outside the builder.

original: When tdd/orchestrator.ts processes verifier completion through StoryOrchestratorResult, then it reads `phaseOutputs["verifier"]` and applies `readVerdict()` and `categorizeVerdict()`.
refined: After ExecutionPlan.run() returns StoryOrchestratorResult, tdd/orchestrator.ts must read StoryOrchestratorResult.phaseOutputs["verifier"], pass that value to readVerdict() function, and then pass the result to categorizeVerdict() function.

original: Given StoryOrchestratorResult.success is false and config.tdd.rollbackOnFailure is true, when tdd/orchestrator.ts completes plan.run(), then it triggers rollback to initialRef.
refined: When tdd/orchestrator.ts receives StoryOrchestratorResult with success=false and config.tdd.rollbackOnFailure=true, it must invoke rollback(initialRef) before returning from the orchestrator.
